description: Update template properties like name, dimensions, background color, or tags. Tags use replace semantics — pass the full desired tag list. Changing dimensions or background will regenerate the preview in the background.

background_color.description: Background color of the first page (page 0) in hex format (#RRGGBB)

page_backgrounds.description: Per-page background colors to merge, keyed by page index string

tags.description: Replace all tags on this template. Pass [] to clear all tags. Omit to leave tags unchanged.

template_id.description: The UUID of the template to update

name: layerre_update_template
title: Update template
